guidance.statement: Ambernath and Danapur plant capacity augmentation should be finalized this year.
guidance.quote: If everything goes well by this financial year that is Ambernath from 2 lakh bottles to 3 lakh bottles and Danapur from 1 lakh to 2 lakh bottles.

guidance.statement: We will try to come back to INR150 crores in the non-convenience fee segment.
guidance.quote: we will try to come back to INR150 crores in this segment also.

guidance.statement: We will try to maintain catering margins between 10% to 12%.
guidance.quote: catering margin traditionally have been between 10% to 12%. So we will try to maintain that.

guidance.statement: Around 20 Vande Bharat sleeper trains may be introduced in the next year.
guidance.quote: normally there may be around 20 Vande Bharat sleeper trains introduced in this financial year or the period of next one year.

guidance.statement: Post RBI license, we will expand iPay across IRCTC services and private market.
guidance.quote: once we have the RBI license, we may express our expanse across IRCTC, number one.

achieved.claim: Total revenue reached INR1,370 crores, up 18.1% year-on-year for the quarter.
Profit after tax stood sustainably at INR330 crores for the quarter.
Catering recorded revenue of INR732 crores, achieving 33.82% year-on-year growth.
Internet ticketing revenue stood at INR361 crores, up about 0.5% year-on-year.

pushback.concern: Sanjay Jain's resignation and potential material discrepancies within company.
Availability of third-party bottled water brands reflecting supply gaps.
Decline in internet ticketing EBIT margins compared to historical levels.
Convenience fee revenue has not grown despite inflation and passenger growth.

output.tone_why: Management addresses challenges directly while highlighting strong overall revenue growth and strategic expansion plans.
